title: Pocketwire Rewards Redemption Terms for Cash, Gift Cards and Charity
content:
Pocketwire Rewards points can be redeemed for cash to the personal balance, a digital gift card or a partner charity donation, subject to the terms below. The tier figures named here are the tier's pending period, redemption increment, cash and gift card or charity minimums, cash value per point, partner charities, matching donation percentage, daily cash limit, fulfilment time and cancellation window.

## Terms

1. Points can be redeemed only while the membership status is active, as the membership record shows before the redemption.
2. Only redeemable points can be redeemed; points stay pending for the tier's pending period in calendar days after they are credited. Redeemable points are the points balance less the points of earning entries, boost entries, bonus entries and referral bonus entries credited within the last pending period in calendar days.
3. A redemption is a whole multiple of the tier's redemption increment and at least the tier's minimum cash redemption for cash, or the tier's minimum gift card or charity redemption for a gift card or charity.
4. Cash value is the points multiplied by the tier's cash value per point, divided by 100 and rounded down to the cent.
5. The former valuation clauses, gift card value as the points multiplied by the tier's gift card value per point and donation value as the points multiplied by the tier's charity value per point, are no longer in force. They are superseded by the current basis for valuing gift card and charity redemptions.
6. A charity redemption goes only to one of the tier's partner charities, and Pocketwire adds the tier's matching donation percentage of the donation value as its own donation, which is not credited to the member.
7. Cash redemptions on one calendar day, the points already redeemed to cash that day plus the new one, may not exceed the tier's daily cash limit; the calendar day is the handling day in Eastern Time. A cash redemption is paid into the linked personal account the same day, which needs that account to be able to receive an internal credit.
8. A redemption is the member's own decision to spend their points and is confirmed by the member in the app.
9. Gift cards and donations are fulfilled within the tier's fulfilment time in business days. The member can cancel one within the tier's cancellation window in full hours of the redemption as long as it is not yet fulfilled, and one that cannot be fulfilled is reversed.
10. A reversal returns the same points, and cash redemptions can never be reversed.
11. A redemption is reversed at most once: a redemption whose ledger already carries a reversal entry or a fulfilment entry for it is not reversed.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- Redeemable points: a balance of 12000 points with an earning entry of 800 points and a boost entry of 200 points credited within the pending period leaves 11000 redeemable points.
- Cash value: 2500 points at a cash value of 0.90 cents per point is 2250 cents, which is 22.50 USD.
- Daily cash limit: with a daily cash limit of 50000 points and 40000 points already redeemed to cash today, a new cash redemption of 10000 points reaches the limit exactly and is within it; one of 10500 points would exceed it.

## Which redemptions can be reversed

| Redemption | Cancel within the window before fulfilment | Reversed when it cannot be fulfilled |
|---|---|---|
| Cash to personal balance | No | No |
| Digital gift card | Yes | Yes, the same points returned |
| Partner charity donation | Yes | Yes, the same points returned |

superseded_clauses: gift card value points times gift_card_cents_per_point
